title: Lantern Lake Fishing [left in English, not translated]
hud.reel: Reel in [on its own 'Recoger' most often means 'pick up' or 'collect'; it reads as reeling in only from the fishing context]
catch.success: You caught: {fish} ({rarity})! [the colon between 'you caught' and the fish is a UI-style break, slightly stiff in Spanish but clear]
rarity.mythic: Mythic [masculine form; after a feminine fish name such as 'Carpa dorada' or 'Anguila farol' it does not agree in gender, though it reads acceptably as a tag in parentheses]
pass.auto_reel: Auto-pickup [coined word, not standard Spanish; 'recogida' suggests pickup or collection rather than reeling in]
pass.lucky_bait: Lucky Bait doubles your chances of landing rare fish!
ascend.confirm: Ascend now? You'll start from scratch, but you'll catch rare fish {bonus}% more often.
weather.storm: A storm is coming! Rare fish are biting.
quest.title: Quests
quest.catch_n: Catch fish in Lunar Bay: {n} [unclear whether {n} is the number to catch or the number caught so far]
quest.claim: Claim [in everyday Spanish 'reclamar' leans toward 'demand' or 'complain'; common in games for claiming rewards, so still understandable]
friends.boost: Fishing with friends gives you +{percent}% luck
afk.kicked: You went too long without moving, so you've stopped fishing. [says only that your fishing stopped, not that you were removed from the game; reads a little as if you stopped by choice]
daily.streak: Streak day {day}! Come back tomorrow for more.
tip.night: Tip: some fish only bite at night.
group.join: Join our community and get 50 free bait!
